title: Reynoutrin|Quercetin-3-O-xyloside|CAS 549-32-6
abstract:
#### Relationship with [Quercetin (B1663063)](https://www.benchchem.com/product/b1663063) and other Quercetin Glycosides (e.g., [Rutin (B1680289)](https://www.benchchem.com/product/b1680289), [Isoquercitrin (B50326)](https://www.benchchem.com/product/b50326), Hyperoside)  
Reynoutrin is structurally related to quercetin, being a quercetin O-glycoside with a xylose unit at the C-3 position [nih.gov](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/Quercetin-3-O-beta-D-xylopyranoside). Quercetin is a widely distributed flavonol and serves as the aglycone for numerous glycosides, including rutin, isoquercitrin, and [hyperoside (B192233)](https://www.benchchem.com/product/b192233) [nih.gov](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/Quercetin)[nih.gov](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7824064/).  
Several studies highlight the co-occurrence of reynoutrin with other quercetin glycosides and quercetin itself in various plants:  
In Psidium cattleianum leaves, reynoutrin was isolated along with other flavonoids [abmole.com](https://www.abmole.com/products/reynoutrin.html)[chemfaces.com](https://www.chemfaces.com/natural/Reynoutrin-CFN96236.html).
Analysis of apple cultivars has consistently shown the presence of reynoutrin alongside other quercetin glycosides such as hyperoside, isoquercitrin, rutin, [avicularin (B192226)](https://www.benchchem.com/product/b192226), and [quercitrin (B1678633)](https://www.benchchem.com/product/b1678633) [mdpi.com](https://www.mdpi.com/2076-3921/7/1/20)[nih.gov](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8868230/)[mdpi.com](https://www.mdpi.com/1420-3049/26/4/1095/pdf?version=1613735360)[nih.gov](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33187387/)[journalijbcrr.com](https://journalijbcrr.com/index.php/IJBCRR/article/view/200). In one study on apple peel, the concentrations of quercetin glycosides generally followed the order: hyperoside > quercitrin > avicularin > reynoutrin > isoquercitrin > rutin, although the order of avicularin and quercitrin could vary by cultivar [mdpi.com](https://www.mdpi.com/2076-3921/7/1/20).  
In the leaves of Eranthis longistipitata, reynoutrin was identified among a diverse group of flavonoids, including quercetin, [kaempferol (B1673270)](https://www.benchchem.com/product/b1673270), hyperoside, rutin, and isoquercitrin [windows.net](https://rcastoragev2.blob.core.windows.net/d4841807d75d8ba04bd5e223641dad72/PMC8539099.pdf).  
A study on Spiraea hypericifolia extract identified reynoutrin along with a range of other flavonols, including quercetin, hyperoside, isoquercitrin, avicularin, and rutin [nih.gov](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37762175/).
Reynoutrin itself is a glycoside, featuring a β-D-xylopyranoside attached to quercetin at the C-3 position. [researchgate.net](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/326036415_POM_analyses_immunomodulatory_cytotoxic_activities_and_polyphenolic_constituents_of_Callistemon_viridiflorus_fruits)[naturalproducts.net](https://coconut.naturalproducts.net/compound/coconut_id/CNP0388516.2) The synthesis of novel glycoside and methyl derivatives involves altering the sugar moiety or introducing methyl groups at various positions on the flavonoid structure. While specific details on novel glycoside and methyl derivatives of Reynoutrin are not extensively detailed in the provided search results, research on other flavonoids, like [isoetin (B191580)](https://www.benchchem.com/product/b191580) and quercetin, indicates that such modifications are a common strategy in flavonoid research to explore structure-activity relationships. [researchgate.net](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/280095310_Isoetin_and_its_derivatives_Analytics_chemosystematics_and_bioactivities)[semanticscholar.org](https://pdfs.semanticscholar.org/a67d/e1475e232ea1a3f8ea9b515d7eed1450da1d.pdf) For example, studies on quercetin derivatives have explored modifications at the C3, C3', and C5 hydroxyl groups, demonstrating that such changes can influence antiviral activity.
